hooks.command: if git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet; then git switch staging-2 >&2 && git pull --ff-only origin staging-2 >&2 && echo "Session started on staging-2 (up to date)."; else echo "WARNING: uncommitted changes, did not switch to staging-2. Current branch: $(git branch --show-current). AGENTS.md requires staging-2."; fi || echo "WARNING: could not switch to or update staging-2. Current branch: $(git branch --show-current)."
